full_judgment: 12. Subsequently the suit was renumbered as Artha Rin Suit No. 304 of 2003. The Artha Rin Adalat also framed issue No. 2 on the point whether the suit is Sable to be decreed in terms of compromise under Order XXIII, rule 3 of the Code of Civil Procedure along with other issues. The Artha Rin Adalat after hearing by judgment and decree dated 15-10-2006 decreed the suit in favour of the respondent No.3 bank and against the petitioner for an amount of Taka 8,89,94,800 and decided the issue No.2 against the petitioners upon a finding that the present petitioners did not prepare any solenama as per terms of the sanction letter dated 25-2-1995 and that there was a condition for giving an undertaking by the petitioners to the effect that they will run the mill by arranging working capital.
